## Эксперименты

- exactly-once-limbo-telegrambot-bounded-replay: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. Bounded replay of original TelegramBot control flow and send_telegram at pinned commit under fake transport, plus selected original LIMBO World/ToolRuntime fault contracts. Does not validate Telegram API behavior, deployment or production frequency. TelegramBot replay: 120 of 180 synthetic paired-run trajectories duplicated across nine injected fault modes (20 each). Original LIMBO control: no-key x contract duplicated in 60/60 selected fault episodes; stable-key mastodon contract duplicated in 0/60. A separate reservation-only model avoided duplicates but missed 20/20 timeout_pre deliveries; these are bounded test outcomes, not production rates. Fake service ledger is the independent oracle; no real message IDs, provider acknowledgements, or actual Telegram idempotency contract. Sequential synthetic runs; network/IO/process latency not benchmarked. The stable idempotency key result belongs to the illustrative LIMBO mastodon service only. Manual UNCERTAIN policy trades duplicates for potential missing delivery. [Артефакт](../../data/results/exactly-once-limbo/2026-11-04.json) · [Артефакт](../../experiments/2026-11-04-limbo-telegrambot-send-retry.py)
- limbo-telegrambot-policy-ab-2026-11-06: SYNTHETIC / OBSERVED. 5 independent seeds, each 180 paired fault cases on actual TelegramBot main/send_telegram with mock service effect ledger. For 900 cases/arm: baseline 600 duplicates/0 missing; sidecar no-retry policy 100 duplicates/200 missing; hypothetical non-Telegram server idempotency 0/0. CPU/wall/latency and Python memory/process IO measured. Pinned TelegramBot b47c527; no real Telegram calls. Synthetic equal-frequency injected faults; sidecar policy exists only in wrapper, no real crash durability or reconciliation; provider idempotency contract NOT available on Telegram; no actual network latency, token usage, real disk IO or cost comparison.
